title: Three Years and One Short Bell
subtitle: 努力坚持 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 努力坚持（人与自我·做人与做事·努力与坚持）
meta: 主题语境：努力坚持（人与自我·做人与做事·努力与坚持）　|　核心词汇：progress　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 progress 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1961 the headmaster ① made the progress that no student in the school would have noted, and he said the making was the whole of the year. The ② progress, meaning the advance itself and not the bell, ran three years and stayed unnoted in the book; progress, he said, is the only thing in a school that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ sort of progress in that school had the same short bell beside it, and the ④ progress at the far gate, meaning the prize they kept for the children to win and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Progress, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the headmaster said the noting is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the progress was the whole of the matter, meaning the hope and not the advance. The ⑥ progress, meaning the hope and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; progress, he said, is either something you make or the only word that means both advance and a hope. He said the hope is the part they remember.

By 1966 the ⑦ progress had become a line in a record, and the record had become an argument about the short bell. The ⑧ progress of the whole thing, the headmaster wrote in October, was one school and three years of noting; progress, he said, is either the prize at the far gate or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ progress I remember is the progress noted in the record, which closed in 1968 and is still noted as the quietest in the school. ⑩ Progress, my mother said in 1970, is the only thing that improves by being noted; all progress, she said, is a hope that has agreed to look like advance. She said the hope was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 进步；进展（指学堂里每一类旁边的那一类）
B. n. 进步；进展（指那分进步本身，与小小的铜铃相对）
C. 固定搭配：make the progress 取得这一分进步
D. n. 进步；进展（指留给孩子们争的那一份）
E. n. 进步之事（抽象总称，指一处学堂的进步之事）
F. n. 进步；进展（指学籍册里写到、被记下的那一分）
G. n. 进步、盼头（指一件事里人人都守却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 盼头（抽象总称，指人人都守却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: made the progress that no student in the school would have noted
The progress, meaning the advance itself and not the bell
Every sort of progress in that school
the progress at the far gate
the progress was the whole of the matter
the progress had become a line in a record
The progress of the whole thing

answers.why: make the progress 意为“取得这一分进步”，1961 年那位校长把学堂里没有一位学生肯记下的一分进步做了一遍。
progress 意为“进步；进展”，指那分进步本身而不是小小的铜铃，它经过了三个学年而在簿子上没有被记下。
progress 意为“进步；进展”，指学堂里每一类旁边的那一类，每一类旁边都有同一只小小的铜铃。
progress 意为“进步；进展”，指最远那道校门的留给孩子们争的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
progress 意为“进步、盼头”，指一件事里人人都守却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这分盼头就是那件事的全部。
progress 意为“盼头”，指人人都守却无人提起的那样东西而不是那分进步，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
progress 意为“进步；进展”，指学籍册里写到、被记下的那一分，到 1966 年这一分成了学籍册里的一行。
progress 意为“进步之事”，校长十月写道，整件事的进步之事是一处学堂和三个学年的记下。
progress 意为“进步；进展”，我记得的是学籍册里记下过的那一分，1968 年办完了，至今仍被说成学堂里最安静的一分。
progress 为抽象总称，母亲 1970 年说，进步是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的进步。
